messages:
maya: Quick debrief  Vertex interview finished. Recording + raw transcript in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/vertex-interview. Need redlined transcript, public-safe quote, embargo date, hero clip for socials, webinar slide stat, captions (EN/ES), and lead-routing tags.

eli: They said 'cut inference cost in half' on the call. Legal will likely ask for softened language. Also asked to use their logo on the landing.

rachel: I'll produce a 30s hero clip + 3x15s webinar snippets. Ops, can you confirm tagging and UTMs?

legal-bot: Checklist: NDA present, release form required. Redact internal IDs and exact p99/p95 numbers. Recommended public phrasing: "reduced inference costs by ~50%". If they request exact numbers publically, require telemetry addendum. Attach redlined transcript to the release before final sign-off.

elsie: (note) sending two quote options to customer now: 1) "Redwood reduced our inference costs by ~50% and improved latency." 2) "We saw significant latency and cost improvements after switching to Redwood."

ops-bot: Suggested UTMs: ?utm_campaign=vertex_spotlight&utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social. Routing rule: lead_tag=case-high -> assign to AE Omar (omar@redwood.ai) with high-touch priority. Will stage pixel after embargo confirmed.

rachel: Clips ETA EOD today. I'll upload to Drive and tag assets with UTMs. EN captions done, ES captions pending vendor (TranscribeNow preferred for speed).

maya: Proposed embargo: 2026-05-12 09:00 PT. Sound ok?

eli: That fits webinar timing. I'll ask customer to sign the public quote and logo usage. Sending now.

legal-bot: Reminder to include release template `customer-release-v2`. Legal will flip green after signed release + redlined transcript.

eli: Customer replied: approved public phrasing 1 and OK'ed logo. Signed PDF uploaded to Drive.

ops-bot: Received signed release. Staging HubSpot flow and pixel for tests. Routing test passed; AE Omar assignment works.

rachel: Uploaded clips + EN captions: https://drive.redwood.ai/vertex/assets (hero_30s.mp4, webinar_15s_1.mp4, webinar_15s_2.mp4, webinar_15s_3.mp4, captions_en.srt). ES captions incoming.

maya: Redlined transcript attached to release form. Legal, over to you for final review.

legal-bot: Final review complete  no PII, public copy approved, telemetry addendum not required. Embargo cleared.

maya: Great. Ops, please schedule landing + social publish for 2026-05-12 09:00 PT and include webinar CTA for 2026-05-26 deep-dive. Tag leads as `case-high` so Omar gets them.

ops-bot: Scheduled. Landing publish and social queue will trigger at embargo time. HubSpot rules and pixel live.

ae-omar: I'll prep outreach templates and monitor incoming demo leads at launch. Thanks team :rocket:
